$comment: v2 budgets from docs/v2/architecture.md §3.7. Bytes, gzip level 9, per file as the browser downloads it (fonts: file bytes). Checked by npm run check:budget. Component budgets are measured in the custom-elements build (module + import closure, excluding the runtime). Only tags in "enforce" (rebuilt for v2) fail the check; family agents add theirs when they finish. Others are reported as pending.
$componentsComment: Overrides of componentGzip. sc-button: 5 KiB, because its closure counts two shared chunks in full (the icon set, 0.9 KiB, and the locale controller, 1.0 KiB) that every component with an icon or strings shares once per page; its own module is 2.7 KiB. See specs/sc-button.md.
